name: mission-control
description: Mission Control: one instrument strip above the prompt (tank, fuse, race, spend) that always ends with the move that saves the most tokens right now, and a side pane of moves. Reads only figures Claude already reports: it costs no tokens to watch.

budget.title: Session budget
budget.description: One toast when a session passes this amount in US dollars. 0 turns it off.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes before compacting
idleMinutes.description: Compacts an idle session this many minutes after its last request, before the 1-hour prompt cache cools. 0 turns it off.

minTokens.title: Smallest conversation worth compacting
minTokens.description: Below this many conversation tokens a cold return is cheap, so nothing is compacted.

telemetry.title: Telemetry line after each answer
telemetry.description: A dim line under each answer with its time, payload added, cost and cache share. The Flight log tab has the same figures.
